draft_notes.mechanism: Leave open blue components unchanged. Closed components get red exterior Chebyshev-adjacent halos. Native lining paints boundary of one or two constituent interior rectangles. A second visible hypothesis paints only cells touching blue; demos must identify lining or query outputs must agree.
draft_notes.native_decomposition_proof: Rectangle union has one horizontal/vertical split except L-shaped aligned-end union with two. The native tiniest-chunk constraint selects the split with strictly smaller minimum piece area; ties are rejected by constructor. Direct source enumerates cuts; independent gate enumerates corner-anchored rectangles with rectangular complements and selects same unique minimum-area partition.
draft_notes.constructor_proposal: No native constructor change. Archived touch-only solution disagrees on 10/100 initial native samples with long interior seams. Uniform piece-lining model matches 1000/1000 fresh draws before context gate. Do not suppress these harder seam cases. Instead supply discriminating demonstrations.
draft_notes.independent_gate: arc_agi2.outline_teaching_evidence.require_outline_teaching_evidence. It never reads query outputs and rejects contradictory demos or unresolved seam hypotheses. Source has no least-mismatch fallback and no D4 parameter oracle.
